paragraphs.text: Cyber Vaar – Har Screen Crime Scene is an Indian crime thriller web series directed by Ankush Bhatt. Produced by Tanveer Bookwala under the banner of Ding Entertainment, it features Mohit Malik and Sanaya Irani. The series released 10 June 2022 on streaming platform Voot and has 20 episodes. It ended on 19 August 2022.
Archika Khurana from The Times Of India rated the series 2.5 out of 5 and overall praised the lead actors Mohit Malik and Sanaya Irani of the series.
Neha Farheen from Aaj Tak shared her critical review stating that the story of the web series is average.
